parsed.explanation: No traveller-facing trans offence, entry screening, facility ban, or documented police/border targeting; visitor uses home passport, so the unimplemented resident gender-recognition regime is not counted against the visitor. Courts have struck down anti-LGBT expression restrictions and created partnership registration, incitement is banned, and Pride grew with scale, showing some functioning recourse. Against that, police were found to have failed to protect an LGBT assembly from hostile provocators, hate-crime victim support is systemicly lacking, and large counter-protests and negative public attitudes document societal hostility with uneven protection. No violence rate, custody, ward or visitor-service data is documented - uncertainty, not proven safety. This fits reduced/elevated borderline risk, below jurisdictions with documented acceptance plus working visitor remedies.
